regionalModel: Metropolitan French reference; regional variants require review

lessons.title: Carry /s/ and /f/ into a clear vowel
lessons.objective: Sustain the initial /s/ or /f/ briefly, then move into the vowel without adding an extra syllable.
lessons.focus: Compare sac, sucre, fleur, and fil. Let air pass continuously at the start of /s/ and /f/, then keep the following French vowel steady.

words.fr: La fleur est dans le sac.
words.en: The flower is in the bag.

words.fr: Je fais une photo dans le salon.
words.en: I take a photo in the living room.

words.fr: Le fil est sur le sac.
words.en: The thread is on the bag.

reader.fr: Dans le salon, je prépare une fleur pour une photo.
reader.en: In the living room, I prepare a flower for a photo.

reader.fr: Je trouve un fil sur mon sac.
reader.en: I find a thread on my bag.

reader.fr: Je mets la fleur dans le sac et je fais la photo.
reader.en: I put the flower in the bag and take the photo.

reader.fr: Ensuite, je demande : « Tu veux du sucre ? »
reader.en: Then I ask, 'Do you want some sugar?'

speaking.scene: Preparing a flower photo at home
speaking.opening: Je fais une photo dans le salon.
goals: Point out the thread on the bag.

see.prompt: Group sac, sucre, salon, fleur, fil, and photo by initial /s/ or /f/.

recall.prompt: Recall the French word for flower before revealing it.

hear.prompt: Listen for sac or fil in the recorded sentence.

type.prompt: Type the French sentence for 'The flower is in the bag.'
type.answerRef: La fleur est dans le sac.

say.prompt: Ask your friend whether they want some sugar.

write.prompt: Write two French sentences about the photo and where the flower is.

lessons.title: Read /k/ in c and qu spellings
lessons.objective: Recognize and pronounce /k/ in familiar French c and qu words while ordering at a café.
lessons.focus: Compare café and carte with qui and quel. The spelling changes, but the opening /k/ sound remains. Read the whole word before choosing a spelling rule.

words.fr: La carte est sur la table.
words.en: The menu is on the table.

words.fr: Il y a quatre tables près de la cuisine.
words.en: There are four tables near the kitchen.

reader.fr: Au café, la carte est sur la table.
reader.en: At the café, the menu is on the table.
I ask, 'Which coffee are you having?'

reader.fr: Mon ami demande qui prépare le café.
reader.en: My friend asks who prepares the coffee.

reader.fr: Nous voyons quatre tables près de la cuisine.
reader.en: We see four tables near the kitchen.

speaking.opening: La carte est sur la table.
goals: Ask which coffee your friend wants.

see.prompt: Find the /k/ spelling at the start of café, carte, qui, and quel.

recall.prompt: Recall the French word for menu before revealing it.

hear.prompt: Listen for carte or café in the recorded sentence.

type.prompt: Type the French sentence for 'The menu is on the table.'
type.answerRef: La carte est sur la table.

say.prompt: Ask who prepares the coffee, keeping /k/ clear in qui and café.

write.prompt: Write a French café exchange asking which coffee your friend wants and who makes it.

lessons.title: Read hard /g/ in g and gu spellings
lessons.objective: Use the French /g/ sound in g and gu words while asking for directions at a station.
lessons.focus: Compare gare and gomme with guide and guitare. The written u in guide and guitare keeps g hard before i; do not pronounce it as a separate /u/ in these words.

words.fr: Le guide attend à la gare.
words.en: The guide is waiting at the station.

words.fr: Ma guitare est dans mon bagage.
words.en: My guitar is in my luggage.
The station is on the left.

reader.fr: Le guide nous attend à la gare.
reader.en: The guide is waiting for us at the station.

reader.fr: Il dit que la sortie est à gauche.
reader.en: He says the exit is on the left.

reader.fr: Ma guitare est dans mon bagage.
reader.en: My guitar is in my luggage.

reader.fr: Je demande au guide où poser mon bagage.
reader.en: I ask the guide where to put my luggage.

speaking.scene: Meeting a guide at a station
speaking.opening: Bonjour, je cherche le guide à la gare.
goals: Ask where the guide is waiting.
Explain that the guitar is in your luggage.
Confirm that the exit is on the left.

see.prompt: Compare the hard /g/ spelling in gare, gomme, guide, and guitare.

recall.prompt: Recall the French word for train station before revealing it.

hear.prompt: Listen for guide or guitare in the recorded station sentence.

type.prompt: Type the French sentence for 'The guide is waiting at the station.'
type.answerRef: Le guide attend à la gare.

say.prompt: Tell the guide that your guitar is in your luggage.
say.answerRef: Ma guitare est dans mon bagage.

write.prompt: Write two French sentences saying where the station is and what is in your luggage.
